प्रदक्षिण a.
1 Being placed or
standing on the right, moving to
the right.
--2 Respectful,
reverential.
--3 Auspicious, of good omen.
--णः, --णा, --णं Circumambulation
from left to right, so that the right
side is always turned towards the
person or object circumambulated, a
reverential salutation made by
walking in this manner;

.
--णं ind.
1 From left to
right.
--2 Towards the right side, so
that the right side is always
turned towards the person or object
circumambulated.
--3 In a
southern direction, towards the south;

. (प्रदक्षिणीकृ or प्रदक्षिणयति
Den. P. means ‘to go round from
left to right’ as a mark of respect;
प्रदक्षिणीकुरुष्व सद्योहुताग्नीन् Ś. 4; प्रद
क्षिणीकृत्य हुतं हुताशनं

).
--Comp.
--अर्चिस् a. flaming
towards the right, having the flames
turned towards the right;
[]
प्रदक्षिणार्चिर्हविरग्निराददे

.
--आवर्त, --आवृत्क a. turned towards
the right.
--क्रिया going round from
left to right, keeping the right side
towards one as a mark of
respect;

1 Rending, tearing.
--2 (a)
A fracture, crack, cleft crevice,
chasm;

. (b) Breach,
hole.
--3 The dispersion of an
army.
--4 An arrow.
--5 A kind of
disease of women.

To burn.
--2 To
consume, destroy completely.
--3 To pain,

--4 To trouble, tease. --Pass.
To take or catch fire, be burnt.
प्रदग्ध p. p. Burnt up, consumed.

To grant, give, offer.
present; स्वं प्रागह प्रादिषि नामराय किं
नाम तस्मै मनसा नराय

--3 To give, give away; yield.
--4 To give up, deliver.

प्रद a.
1 (At the end of comp.)
Giving, bestowing, or conferring
on, yielding; सुख˚, ताप˚, सस्य˚ &c.
--2 Liberal, bountiful.
--दा A gift.

प्रदातृ m.
1 A giver, donor.
--2 A
liberal man.
--3 One who gives a
daughter in marriage.
--4 An
epithet of Indra.

1 Giving, granting,

--2 Giving away in marriage;
वैखानसं किमनया
व्रतमाप्रदानाद्व्यापाररोधि भदनस्य निषोवेतव्यं Ś. 1. 27.
--3
Imparting, instructing; विद्या˚.
--4
A gift, donation, present.
--5 A
goad.
--6 An oblation.
--Comp.
--शूरः a very munificent man, donor.

प्रदानकं An offering, a gift,
donation, present.

प्रदायिन्, प्रदायक a. Granting,
givin, bestowing.

प्रदायिन्, प्रदायक a. Granting,
givin, bestowing.

प्रदेय a.
1 To be given, imparted,
communicated &c.

.
--2
To be given in marriage; इमे अपि
प्रदेये Ś. 4.

.
--3 To
give, grant, offer, bestow or
confer upon; विद्ययोः पथि मुनिप्रदिष्टयोः

.

known.

प्रदिश् f.
1 Pointing out.
--2 An
order, direction, command.
--3 A
direction, quarter.
--4 An
intermediate point of the compass; such
as नैरृती, आग्नेयी, ऐशानी and वायवी.

1 Shown, pointed

wall.

प्रदिह् {c2c} U. To besmear, daub,
anoint.

प्रदिग्ध p. p. Besmeared,
bedaubed, anointed.
--ग्धं Meat fried in a
particular way.

1 Anointing, plastering,
unction.
--2 A plaster, thick
ointment.

प्रदीप् {c4c} A. To blaze, flame forth,
shine brilliantly. --

To
kindle, inflame.
--2 To excite,
rouse, stimulate.

1 A lamp, light (fig. also);
अतैलपूराः सरतप्रदीपाः

‘light or ornament of
the family’; 7. 29.
--2 That which
enlightens or elucidates,
elucidation; especially at the end of titles
of works; as in महाभाष्यप्रदीपः,
काव्यप्रदीपः &c.

प्रदीपक a.
1 Illuminating.
--2
Explaining, illustrating.
--कः,
--प्रदीपिका A small lamp.

प्रदीपन a. (नी f.)
1 Kindling.
--2
Illuminating.
--3 Stimulating,
exciting.
--नं The act of kindling,
lighting, stimulating &c.
--नः A
kind of mineral poison.

प्रदीप्त p. p.
1 Kindled, lighted,
inflamed, illuminated.
--2 Blazing,
burning, shining.
--3 Raised,
expanded; प्रदीप्तशिरसमाशीविषं Dk.
--4
Stimulated, excited (hunger &c.).
--Comp.
--प्रज्ञ a. of a bright
intellect, sharp.

To grow worse,
deteriorate.
--2 To be corrupted or
spoiled, be vitiated;

.
--3
To sin, err, commit an offence against,
be faithless or unchaste;

(a) To spoil, corrupt, soil, taint.
(b) To pollute, contaminate, defile.
--2 To blame, censure, find fault
with.

प्रादुस् ind. Visibly, evidently,
manifestly, in sight (used chiefly
with भू, कृ and अस्).

प्रदुष्ट p. p.
1 Spoiled, corrupted.
--2 Wicked, bad, sinful.
--3
Licentious, wanton.

प्रदूषित p. p.
1 Corrupted,
vitiated, spoiled, depraved.
--2
Polluted, defiled, contaminated.

प्रदोष a. Bad, corrupt.
--षः
1 (a)
A fault, defect, sin, offence. (b)
Transgression, violation.
--2
Disordered condition, such as mutiny,
rebellion.
--3 Evening, nightfall,
the first part of the night;
तमःस्वभावास्तेऽप्यन्ये प्रदोषमनुयायिनः Śi. 2. 98
(where प्रदोष primarily means
‘corrupt’ or ‘bad’);
व्रजसुंदरीजनमनस्तोषप्रदोषः

.

--आगमः
nightfall.
--कालः --समयः --वेला
evening-time, nightfall.
--तिमिरं
evening darkness, the dusk of early
night; कामं प्रदोषतिमिरेण न दृश्यसे त्वं

(की f.), Relating to the evening.
प्रदोषक a. Born in the evening.

To see, behold.

प्रदर्शक a.
1 Showing,

--2 Foretelling.

प्रद्युत् {c1c} A. To shine forth.
--Caus. To illumine, irradiate,
light up.

1 Irradiating, lighting,
illuminating.
--2 Splendour, light,
lustre.
--3 A ray of light.
--4 N. of
a king of Ujjayinī, whose daughter
Vatsa married; प्रद्योतस्य प्रियदुहितरं
वत्सराजोऽत्र जह्ने Me. (considered as
an interpolation by Malli.);

प्रद्युम्नः An epithet of Cupid, the
god of love. [He was a son of Kṛṣṇa
and Rukmiṇī. When only six years
old, he was stolen away by the demon
Śambara, for he was foretold that
Pradyumna would be his destroyer.
Śambara cast the child into the roaring sea,
and a large fish swallowed it. This
fish was caught by a fisherman and
taken to the demon; and when it was
cut up, a beautiful child came out from
[]
the belly, and Māyāvatī, the
mistress of Śambara's household, at the
desire of Nārada, carefully reared him
from childhood. As he grew up, she
was fascinated by the beauty of his
person, but Pradyumna reproved her for
entertaining towards himself feelings so
unbecoming a mother as he considered
her. But when he was told that he was
not her son, but of Viṣṇu and was cast
into the sea by Śambara, he became
enraged, and challenging him to fight,
succeeded in killing him by the force of
illusions. He and Māyāvatī afterwards
repaired to the house of Kṛṣṇa, where
Nārada told him and Rukmini that the
boy was their own and that Māyāvatī
was his wife].

प्रद्वार्, प्रद्वारं A place before a
